# SoloStack

> SoloStack curates software tools, hardware, stack blueprints and AI automation guides for solopreneurs, indie hackers and creators running one-person businesses. Operated by FXN Holdings (Australia).

## Main sections
- [Articles & guides](https://solostack.au/posts): practical how-to guides on tech stacks, hosting, marketing and operations
- [Software directory](https://solostack.au/tools): reviews and pricing for tools suited to solo operators
- [Stack blueprints](https://solostack.au/stacks): complete toolchains for a specific outcome
- [Comparisons](https://solostack.au/comparisons): head-to-head software and hardware comparisons
- [Best gear for creators](https://solostack.au/best-gear): recommended equipment
